title: Quenched Silky Australian Chicken Nimono
description: An energizing and flavorful dish featuring the rich taste of ginger garlic paste, all wrapped up in a silky nimono simmer.

ingredients.name: ginger garlic paste
ingredients.notes: see notes on homemade ginger garlic paste below

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine ginger and garlic to make the ginger garlic paste.
In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sugar, honey, fish sauce, and rice vinegar.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan and swirl to coat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same pan, add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back to the pan and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
